VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Meta.ConfigNote: Ported from ValeVision3D 41__System__CrossSectionView. Structural and numeric values only. Lengths are stated in real millimetres and converted to world units through VghLantern__Env3d__ConfigAccess, so a number here means the same thing as a number on a drawing.

VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Featur.EnabledNote: Master switch for the cross section tool. False leaves the 3D View overlay without the Cross Section cluster and never builds a cut plane, so the feature costs nothing at all rather than being hidden.
VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Featur.HideGroundGridWhenCutNote: The cut is applied at the renderer, so it takes the ground grid with it and leaves a grid that stops dead along the section line. That reads as a rendering fault rather than as a section, so the grid is dropped for the duration of a cut and restored on return to No Cut.

VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Appear.FillColourNote: The solid cut face, RGB 240,240,240. Matched to ValeVision3D so a lantern sectioned here reads the same as the same lantern sectioned in a ValeVision scene.
VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Appear.LineWidthPxNote: CSS pixels, zoom invariant, following the same reasoning as the setting-out linework: a section profile is read on screen, not issued at a scale.
VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Appear.InsetNote: How far the fill and the profile line sit BEHIND the cut plane, measured along the kept-side normal. Both must be non-zero because the clip is applied globally at the renderer, so anything sitting exactly on the plane is a coin toss away from being clipped with the model. The line is inset less than the fill so it always reads in front of it.

VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Tuning.WeldToleranceNote: Grid that contour endpoints are snapped to before they are chained into loops. This is also what lets two touching solids cancel their shared contact face, which is what produces a clean section with no internal linework. Too fine and loops fail to close on float error; too coarse and a genuine rebate detail welds shut.
VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Tuning.MinLoopAreaNote: Loops smaller than this are discarded as slivers. Deliberately far below the ValeVision value: that tool sections buildings, this one sections a glazing bar, and a 20 mm2 loop is a real detail here rather than noise.
VghLantern__CrossSection__Config__Tuning.MaxCrossingSegmentsNote: Hard safety ceiling on contour segments per recompute. Tripping it abandons the fill and the profile line but leaves the clip itself active, so the model is still cut - it just loses its painted face rather than locking the browser.
